title: Honeymotes
description: Honeymotes is a datapack that adds a myriad of fun emotes and visual gags to the game. Honeymotes do not impact gameplay and are purely visual in nature. They work in survival/creative mode as well as single/multiplayer!
body:
Honeymotes is a datapack that adds a myriad of fun emotes and visual gags to the game. Honeymotes do not impact gameplay and are purely visual in nature. They work in survival/creative mode as well as single/multiplayer!

For players who like running silly commands, but don't want things to get out of control, Hoenymotes allow for astoundingly strange emotes without affecting the game or the world!
